experience.title: Volunteer Gen 6 - VNOI
experience.summary: Proposed problems, generated test cases, performed testing, and created contests.

content.text: During my time as a volunteer at VNOI (Vietnam Olympiad in Informatics), a non-profit community dedicated to fostering programming skills and competitive programming culture among Vietnamese students, I contributed by proposing problem statements, generating test cases, performing thorough testing, and creating contests. VNOI’s mission is to nurture young talent, provide resources for learning algorithms and data structures, and build a supportive environment for those passionate about informatics. I chose this volunteer role because I wanted to give back to the community, support the next generation of programmers, and strengthen the culture of knowledge-sharing and collaboration in Vietnam’s tech scene.

experience.title: Member - Sakura Science Club
experience.summary: Exchange program participant in Japan and active member of a science-focused non-profit organization.

content.text: My exchange journey in Japan was an unforgettable experience. I had the opportunity to visit prestigious universities such as the University of Tokyo, Tokyo Institute of Science, and Waseda University. One of the highlights was meeting Nobel Laureate Takaaki Kajita, whose insights deeply inspired me. I also collaborated on projects and cultural exchanges with friends from Japan, China, Thailand, and Indonesia, which broadened my perspective and strengthened international friendships. Beyond academics, I was amazed by Japan’s cutting-edge technology and innovation, which left a lasting impression on me.

items: Exposure to world-class universities and research environments
Inspiration from meeting Nobel Laureate Takaaki Kajita
Cross-cultural collaboration with peers from multiple Asian countries
First-hand experience of Japan’s advanced technology and innovation

content.text: This journey taught me the value of knowledge-sharing, cultural diversity, and innovation.

blogs.title: Olympic AI Roadmap
blogs.summary: A simple roadmap that gathers key knowledge and outlines the learning path for Olympic AI.

content.text: The idea for my Olympic AI Roadmap came from my own experience competing in VOAI, where I realized there were very few clear resources or structured learning paths for such a unique competition. After facing the challenge myself, I decided to collect and organize the essential knowledge into a roadmap that could guide future participants.

items: The importance of having a structured study plan for unusual competitions
How to synthesize knowledge from scattered resources
The value of sharing experiences to help others prepare better

content.text: From scarcity of resources came the motivation to build a clear path for others.
